allow: Shell(cd /tmp echo "=== section headings present? ===" for s in "Want anything to be easy" "90+" "We Provide Many Features" "Choose Your Plan" "Huge Global Network" "Trusted by Thousands" "Subscribe Now for Get" "LaslesVPN is a private"; do c=$(grep -c "$s" laslesvpn_home.html) echo "[$c] $s" done echo "=== PHP warnings/notices as HTML comments ===" grep -oE "(Warning|Notice|Fatal error|Deprecated|Undefined)[^<]*" laslesvpn_home.html | head -20 || echo "none" echo "=== image srcs ===" grep -oE 'src="[^"]*(hero|map|avatar|logo)\.png[^"]*"' laslesvpn_home.html | sort -u)

Shell(cd /tmp echo "=== avatar references ===" grep -oE 'avatar-[0-9]\.png' laslesvpn_home.html | sort | uniq -c echo "=== testimonial names ===" for n in "Viezh Robert" "Yessica Christy" "Kim Young Jou"; do echo "[$(grep -c "$n" laslesvpn_home.html)] $n" done echo "=== check logo.png / logo wordmark ===" grep -c "laslesvpn-logo" laslesvpn_home.html)

Shell(cd "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD" # Crop full-page (1280x4683) into 6 vertical strips using sips for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5; do y=$((i * 780)) sips -c 780 1280 --cropOffset $y 0 full-page.png --out "strip-$i.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "strip-$i.png cropped at y=$y" || echo "strip-$i FAILED" done ls -la strip-*.png 2>/dev/null | head)

Shell(which magick convert identify 2>/dev/null; echo "---node---"; node --version 2>/dev/null; echo "---check npm png libs---"; ls "$(npm root -g 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "png|sharp|jimp" | head)

Shell(cd "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD" node sample-png.js 2>/dev/null for f in /tmp/fig_extract/images/*; do echo "=== $(basename "$f") ===" node sample-png.js "$f" 2>&1 | grep -E "dimensions|rgb\(" | head -8 echo "" done)
